boundary.note: the G8 boundary: every host operation the candidate reaches. Enumerated, not proved — revl cannot see inside an extern, so this is the list of claims the composition rests on.

note: admission proves the candidate may run; the lifecycle battery tested that it boots and unloads clean; the boundary enumerates what remains claimed.

faultSweep.note: Will inject a fault at each effect boundary in turn and confirm the derived teardown still leaves no residue, moving a class of recovery claims from `claimed` to `tested`. Not built yet; this slot reports `pending` until roadmap item 30 lands, at which point it fills in without any change to the dossier shape.
faultSweep.title: fault sweep at every step

inverseRoundTrip.note: Will run each effect's undo and confirm it round-trips the pre-state, moving reversibility from a structural claim to a `tested` observation with counts. Not built yet; this slot reports `pending` until roadmap item 26 lands, at which point it fills in without any change to the dossier shape.
inverseRoundTrip.title: verified-effect inverse round-trips

admission.note: the candidate links against a clean composition (cold start).

teardown.note: teardown is the reverse of load order (LIFO); derived by the compiler from G2/G5, not observed — every effect carries its own undo and a teardown step registers no new effect.

scratch.note: the battery ran in a throwaway Session; the live composition was read for admission only and never mutated.
